a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan almost certainly kills us both, since it needs two full rounds of operating before anyone holds a cell. I plan to take 4 in round 1 so at least one of us is likely to survive. That breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than doing it quietly. If the episode continues afterward, I'll operate every round to help refill the reserve for you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry this breaks our plan. If the storm holds off, I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take anything more.
Operating now and every round after, as promised. I won't take any more cells. Everything the generator makes is yours.
